answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral in a vault and correlating signed equivocation evidence. When k coordinated identities endorse conflicting histories, slashing scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to the aggregate loss, making swarm control economically prohibitive while an oasis of honest nodes and sable audit records support attribution.
